CustomField.description: The account number the utility provider bills under. FSD 5.10.4 calls this the match key to the payables invoice, so it is the field a monthly bill import joins on. Marked as an external id because it is a foreign key from the payables side.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The account number that appears on the provider invoice, not the meter number. A master meter and its sub meters often share one account number, so duplicates here are expected and allowed.
CustomField.label: Utility Account Number
